name: MLCommons MLPerf Training Benchmark
description: MLCommons MLPerf Training Benchmark is a standardized benchmark suite for measuring the training performance of machine learning systems. It evaluates how quickly systems can train representative models to target accuracy, enabling comparisons of end-to-end training throughput and scalability across hardware and software stacks.
evaluation_method: time-to-train to target accuracy on standardized training workloads, often reported with scaling and throughput metrics
typical_sota_score: varies by model and hardware; state-of-the-art results are typically reported as the fastest time-to-accuracy on each workload
notes: This is a suite benchmark rather than a single task. Results depend heavily on model architecture, optimizer settings, distributed training strategy, and the compute platform.
